description: Source code implementing ASN.1 encoding/decoding and key management functions for Ed25519 keys in OpenSSL, including functions for setting, getting, encoding, decoding, comparing, and freeing keys.

methods.name: ed25519_free
methods.description: Frees the ED25519_KEY structure associated with an EVP_PKEY.

methods.name: ed25519_set_priv_raw
methods.description: Sets a private ED25519 key from raw 32-byte seed.

methods.name: ed25519_set_pub_raw
methods.description: Sets a public ED25519 key from raw 32-byte data.

methods.name: ed25519_get_priv_raw
methods.description: Retrieves the raw 32-byte private key from an EVP_PKEY.

methods.name: ed25519_get_pub_raw
methods.description: Retrieves the raw 32-byte public key from an EVP_PKEY.

methods.name: ed25519_pub_decode
methods.description: Decodes a public key from ASN.1 format.

methods.name: ed25519_pub_encode
methods.description: Encodes a public key into ASN.1 format.

methods.name: ed25519_pub_cmp
methods.description: Compares two public keys for equality.

methods.name: ed25519_priv_decode
methods.description: Decodes a private key from ASN.1 format.

methods.name: ed25519_priv_encode
methods.description: Encodes a private key into ASN.1 format.

methods.name: ed25519_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the key in bytes.

methods.name: ed25519_bits
methods.description: Returns the size of the key in bits.
